description: Make a Qiyuan Q1 robot speak, make a heart gesture, or walk forward after an explicit safety confirmation.

display.description_en: Make a Qiyuan Q1 robot speak, make a heart gesture, or walk forward after an explicit safety confirmation.
display.description_zh: 让启元 Q1 机器人播报文字，并在现场安全确认后执行比心或向前走动作。
examples_en: Ask the Qiyuan robot to say: Welcome to the Qiyuan Robot booth.
After confirming the area is safe, ask the Qiyuan robot to make a heart gesture.
After confirming the path is clear and level, ask the Qiyuan robot to walk forward two steps.
examples_zh: 让启元机器人播报：欢迎来到启元机器人展台。
确认机器人周围安全后，让启元机器人比个心。
确认前方无人、无障碍物且地面平整后，让启元机器人向前走两步。
display.name: 启元机器人执行器
